name: Cable Cross-Body Triceps Extension
steps: Set two cable pulleys around shoulder height, stand centered facing the stack, and cross your arms to grip the opposite cable ball or handle in each hand.
Take a small step back, brace your core, and angle your upper arms slightly out at your sides with bent elbows.
Extend both elbows smoothly down and outward along the path of the cables until both arms straighten completely.
Pause briefly to squeeze your triceps, then bend your elbows slowly to return your hands in front of your chest.
tips: Keep your upper arms fixed in place so all motion occurs cleanly through your elbow joints.
Avoid rounding your shoulders forward or leaning over the cables to force lockouts.
